spans.text: Each agent session (at any depth) can have at most `maxChildrenPerAgent` (default: 5) active children at a time. This prevents runaway fan-out from a single orchestrator.
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates strong tool safety practices. Sub-agents are isolated by default, session tools are denied by default, there are concurrency limits, cascade stop mechanisms, configurable nesting depth caps, per-agent spawn limits to prevent runaway fan-out, and a deny-wins tool policy. The handoff envelope validation also prevents vague or malformed task delegation.
